metas.name: Gilmore Girls: A Year in the Life
metas.description: Set nearly a decade after the finale of the original series, this revival follows Lorelai, Rory and Emily Gilmore through four seasons of change.

metas.name: The Trials of Karen Read
metas.description: A docuseries examining Boston cop John O'Keefe's death and girlfriend Karen Read's controversial trial for his murder. The ase ended in a hung jury in 2024, with prosecutors seeking a retrial while Read's defense aimed to dismiss charges.

metas.name: Blue Eye Samurai
metas.description: In Edo-period Japan, a young warrior driven by a dream of revenge cuts a bloody path toward destiny.

metas.name: Love & Death
metas.description: Candy and Pat Montgomery and Betty and Allan Gore — two churchgoing couples — enjoy their small town Texas life... until an extramarital affair leads somebody to pick up an axe.

metas.name: Unfamiliar
metas.description: Hidden in the middle of Berlin, ex-spies Simon and Meret run the safe house called "The Nest." When a threat they thought was eliminated catches up with them again, they suddenly have to hide from hit men, Russian agents, the Federal Intelligence Service (BND), ex-lovers and a lot of people they have wronged—and try to keep their marriage intact at the same time.

metas.name: Blade Runner 2099
metas.description: Takes place fifty years after the events of "Blade Runner 2049."

metas.name: Top Gear
metas.description: The hosts talk about everything car-related. From new cars to how they're fueled, this show has it all.

metas.name: VeggieTales
metas.description: American series of children's computer-animated episodes featuring anthropomorphic vegetables in stories conveying moral themes based on Christianity. They frequently retell Biblical stories, sometimes anachronistically reframed, and include humorous references to pop culture in many different eras by putting Veggie spins on them.

metas.name: Dead Like Me
metas.description: When her life comes to an abrupt end, George discovers that death is nothing like she thought it would be. Recruited to collect the souls of others as they die, she suddenly finds herself an unwilling participant in a line of work she never knew existed: Grim Reaping!

metas.name: Thomas & Friends
metas.description: Thomas & Friends is a British children's television series, which had its first broadcast on the ITV network on 4 September 1984. It is based on The Railway Series of books by the Reverend Wilbert Awdry and his son, Christopher Awdry. These books deal with the adventures of a group of anthropomorphised locomotives and road vehicles who live on the fictional Island of Sodor. The books were based on stories Wilbert told to entertain his son, Christopher during his recovery from measles. From Series one to four, many of the stories are based on events from Awdry's personal experience.

metas.name: Escape to the Chateau
metas.description: Dick Strawbridge and his partner (subsequently wife) Angel Adoree swap their two-bed flat in Essex for an abandoned French chateau. Can they bring its 45 rooms and acres of land back to life?

metas.name: The Greatest American Hero
metas.description: The chronicles of  teacher Ralph Hinkley's adventures after a group of aliens gives him a red suit that gives him superhuman abilities. Unfortunately, Ralph, who hates wearing the suit, immediately loses its instruction booklet, and thus has to learn how to use its powers by trial and error, often with comical results.

metas.name: Doug
metas.description: Doug Funnie experiences common predicaments while attending school in his new hometown of Bluffington, Virginia.

metas.name: MECH-X4
metas.description: Ryan Walker mysteriously awakens MECH-X4, a giant robot built to defend Bay City against impending doom. When monsters begin to descend, Ryan recruits his two best friends and his brother to help pilot the robot that is their only hope of saving their town from mass destruction.

metas.name: Arranged
metas.description: Viewers follow couples from different backgrounds that have one thing in common – the belief in arranged marriages. From a young Jewish modern Orthodox couple in New York City, to a southern couple from Texas, to a couple raised by traditional East Indian parents living in California – each have a unique journey to marriage.

metas.name: Ugly Betty
metas.description: Wannabe writer Betty Suarez is a plain girl from Queens, who is smart, hardworking and savvy but lacks a fashionable sense of style. When publishing mogul Bradford Meade puts his son Daniel in charge of Mode magazine, he hires Betty to be Daniel's new assistant -- mostly because he knows that she may be the only woman in Manhattan with whom the younger man won't sleep.

metas.name: Breslau
metas.description: Police officer Franz Podolsky investigates a horrifying murder.

metas.name: Disney Presents Goofy in How to Stay at Home
metas.description: Leave it to Goofy to find the fun in staying home!

metas.name: Hostile Planet
metas.description: This six part documentary draws attention to the most extraordinary — almost supernatural — accounts of animals that have adapted to the cruelest evolutionary curveballs.

metas.name: The Wonder Years
metas.description: The story of Kevin Arnold facing the trials and tribulations of youth while growing up during the 1960s and 70s. Told through narration from an adult Kevin, Kevin faces the difficulties of maintaining relationships and friendships on his enthralling journey into adulthood.

metas.name: Dragon Ball Z Kai
metas.description: Rejoin Goku and his friends in a series of cosmic battles! Toei has redubbed, recut, and cleaned up the animation of the original 1989 animated series. The show's story arc has been refined to better follow the comic book series on which it is based. The show also features a new opening and ending. In the series, martial artist Goku, and his various friends, battle increasingly powerful enemies to defend the world against evil. Can Earth's defender defeat demons, aliens, and other villains?

metas.name: Ancient Aliens
metas.description: Science and mythology - and how they are the same thing.

metas.name: Dexter: New Blood
metas.description: Ten years after faking his death in Miami and moving to Upstate New York under an assumed name, Dexter gets an unexpected visit from the son he abandoned.

metas.name: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
metas.description: Real-life and often shocking moments that unfold around the clock: unruly guests, high-pressure special events and the relentless efforts required to keep thousands of people safe and entertained each day.

metas.name: The Pacific
metas.description: Track the intertwined real-life stories of three U.S. Marines – Robert Leckie, John Basilone, and Eugene Sledge – across the vast canvas of the Pacific Theater during World War II. A companion piece to the 2001 miniseries Band of Brothers.

metas.name: Unseamly: The Investigation of Peter Nygård
metas.description: An investigation into multiple allegations of sexual assault and sex trafficking brought against the fashion mogul.

metas.name: Little Disasters
metas.description: A group of new mother friends are torn apart when one is accused of injuring her baby, fracturing their bond and nearly destroying their families.

metas.name: Germany Shore
metas.description: Reality Shore is the first Swiss and German spin-off of the MTV series Jersey Shore.
